title: Is service hurting our reputation?
subtitle: Current public reputation of our service experience across Trustpilot, X, Reddit, App Store and Play Store.
persona: Head of CX — HDFC Credit Cards
_provenance: X (@HDFCBank_Cares, 153 threads) and Reddit (r/CreditCardsIndia +, 75 HDFC posts) are LIVE real data. Trustpilot / App Store / Play Store are MODELLED (not scraped). Every element carries a `source` field: 'live' = derived from real X/Reddit; 'modelled' = demo placeholder. Theme magnitudes are scaled to public-volume; the RANKING is from real data.

service_reputation_score.label: Service Reputation Score
service_reputation_score.verdict: Public service reputation is declining for the 8th week. The forced Swiggy-card migration, 'no-reply / complaint-ignored' threads and competitor-switching are now the dominant external narrative — X drives velocity, Reddit drives the community narrative.

insights.title: Forced Swiggy-card migration is the loudest public narrative
insights.body: High-reach Reddit threads (854 + 549 + 341 upvotes in 395K–1.4M-member communities) on the forced Swiggy card change dominate HDFC card discussion — anger is spreading faster than any service-desk theme.

insights.title: One in two public mentions benchmarks HDFC against a rival
insights.body: 55% of HDFC Reddit posts name a competitor — ICICI (24), Axis (21) and SBI (18) most — customers are publicly using peer cards as the reference for what HDFC service should be.

insights.title: 'No reply / complaint ignored' is the top service grievance on X
insights.body: 32 of 153 public complaint threads are 'no response / DM ignored / case closed unresolved' — the single largest service theme, as recovery-agent and loan-spam harassment newly spike in September.
